15 Temporary directions under s. 13(2).

(1) If the Secretary of State considers that there are grounds for giving a direction under
subsection (2) of section 13 of this Act in respect of a practitioner on account of such
conduct by him as is mentioned in that subsection and that the circumstances of the
case require such a direction to be given with the minimum of delay, he may, subject
to the following provisions of this section, give such a direction in respect of him by
virtue of this section; and a direction under section 13(2) given by virtue of this section
may specify such controlled drugs as the Secretary of State thinks fit.
